interface.title: TissuePlex v0.9.1
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and checking results after NICHESv2 communication inference; making figures
interface.what_it_is_for: Lay a NICHESv2 ligand–receptor communication graph over a spatial transcriptomics section so cells and their signalling edges can be filtered, coloured and inspected, with figures exported.

data.note: Seeded dataset mouse_ileum_demo was already selected in the Dataset dropdown. It has 30 cells, 36 transcripts, 15 genes and 4 LRMs (Csf1|Csf1r, Il6|Il6ra, Tgfb1|Tgfbr1, Wnt5a|Fzd1), plus supplemental cell metadata (cluster, pseudotime) and edge metadata (sending_type, receiving_type, is_autocrine). With no morphology image it draws on a blank frame. The dropdown also lists mouse_ileum_tiny, seqfish_synthetic, visium_hd_tiny and visium_tiny; visium_tiny was opened in Split view and has a morphology image (tissue_hires_image).

tree.general: See where cells signal to each other across a tissue section and check that signal against tissue structure and cell annotations
tree.specific: Explore the NICHESv2 LRM edge graph of mouse_ileum_demo in TissuePlex
